title: Trust Network config bootstraps a safe default (sharing not force-enabled) on first access for a new org
description: TrustNetworkService.getConfig calls repo.upsertConfig(organizationId, {}, ...) when no existing config is found — verify the resulting default does not accidentally expose data (e.g. sharingEnabled should not silently default to true with autoApproveVibrantixClients true).
steps: As a brand-new org with no prior Trust Network activity, call GET /trust-network/config
expectedResult: A config document is created and returned with conservative defaults — no partner is pre-trusted and no pending requests exist for an org that has taken no action.

title: sendLink transitions not_started to assigned exactly once; resending an already-assigned assessment does not error or re-transition
description: AssessmentService.sendLink only calls this.transition(..., 'assigned') when currentDoc.status === 'not_started'; for a later resend (status already 'assigned' or beyond) it skips the transition call entirely, avoiding a workflow error from re-attempting an already-applied edge.
steps: Call sendLink a second time (resend) on the same assessment
expectedResult: A new token/passcode/magic link is generated and the call returns 200 with no transitionWarning — the assessment status remains 'assigned' and no workflow error is thrown.

title: Assessment soft-delete is blocked once an access token has been generated, requiring cancellation first
description: AssessmentService.softDelete throws AppError.conflict when doc.accessToken is set, even if status is in the deletable set (not_started/cancelled), because a vendor may already hold a live URL.
preconditions: An assessment where sendLink was called then later cancelled (status='cancelled', accessToken still set)
steps: Call DELETE /assessments/:id on the cancelled assessment
expectedResult: Request is rejected with 409 'Cannot delete this assessment because a vendor access link has already been sent...' — the document is not removed.

title: An active questionnaire template cannot be edited in place; only editActive() (fork) or update() on a draft is permitted
steps: Call PUT (update) directly on the active template's id with a field change
expectedResult: Request is rejected with 409 'Active templates are immutable. Use editActive() to create a new version instead.' — no in-place mutation of the active document occurs.

title: Evidence list statusCounts aggregation is computed over the same base filter as the paginated result set
description: EvidenceService.list runs a $group aggregation over a manually reconstructed baseFilter (organizationId, isLatest, isDeleted, plus any status/category/vendorId/projectId query params) — a drift between this filter and findWithQuery's own filter would make the stat-card counts disagree with the visible table rows.
preconditions: A vendor with evidence items across at least 3 different statuses
steps: Sum statusCounts values and compare to the `total` field of the paginated result for the same filter
expectedResult: sum(statusCounts) equals the paginated result's total count exactly — the stat cards never show a number inconsistent with what filtering + pagination would return for the same query.

title: Offboarding page's UI falls back to hard-coded mock rows when the API returns an empty list
description: VendorOffboardingPage's `offboardingTasks` computed value falls back to a hard-coded array of 4 fictional offboarding records ('Legacy Systems Inc.', 'OldTech Solutions', etc.) whenever offboardingProcesses.length === 0 — i.e. whenever the API genuinely has zero real offboarding records for the org, not just during a loading state. This is a data-integrity concern independent of the feature-flag redirect (VEND-E2E-006): if the flag were ever re-enabled, a fresh org would see fabricated vendor names as if they were real.
preconditions: OFFBOARDING_ENABLED temporarily flipped to true in a test build, org has zero real offboarding processes
steps: With the feature flag enabled, load /vendors/offboarding for an org with no offboarding processes ever initiated
expectedResult: Flag as a data-integrity finding: the table currently shows 4 fictional vendors ('Legacy Systems Inc.', 'OldTech Solutions', 'DataOld Corp', 'SecurityOld Systems') with fabricated progress/dates instead of a genuine empty state — this must be replaced with a proper empty state before the flag can be safely re-enabled.
